data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to get the installation date of the application.
data.what_it_does: Provides the install date of the application as a DateTime object. On Android, it queries the PackageManager, while on iOS and macOS, it uses the application document directory's creation date.
use_when: You need to know when the app was installed on the user's device
You want a simple integration for Android, iOS, and macOS install dates
avoid_when: You require an actively maintained plugin, as this is currently unmaintained
You need support for platforms other than Android, iOS, and macOS
weaknesses: iOS and macOS implementation relies on document directory creation date rather than system install metadata
